tasks.label: Install WebUI dependencies
args: if (Test-Path WebUI\node_modules) { Write-Host 'WebUI\node_modules already present, skipping install.' } else { Push-Location WebUI; npm install; Pop-Location }

tasks.label: Build WebUI
args: Push-Location WebUI; npm run build; Pop-Location

tasks.label: Run Obstacle Release (standalone only)
args: Get-Process -Name Obstacle -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; cmake --build build --config Release --target Obstacle_Standalone; Start-Process -FilePath ".\build\Obstacle_artefacts\Release\Standalone\Obstacle.exe"

tasks.label: Build + Run Obstacle (Release, standalone + VST3)
args: Get-Process -Name Obstacle -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; if (-not (Test-Path build -PathType Container)) { cmake -S . -B build | Out-Null }; cmake --build build --config Release --target Obstacle_Standalone Obstacle_VST3; Start-Process -FilePath ".\build\Obstacle_artefacts\Release\Standalone\Obstacle.exe"
